mapper.select: SELECT #{yearMonth} as yearMonth, COUNT(*) AS TOTCNT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT(user_id) AS user_id FROM statistic.request_info WHERE request_code = 'L' AND SUBSTR(create_date,1,6) = #{yearMonth} ) A

SELECT #{yearMonth} as yearMonth, COUNT(*) AS TOTCNT FROM ( SELECT A.user_id,B.hr_organ FROM statistic.request_info A LEFT OUTER JOIN statistic.users B ON A.user_id = B.user_id WHERE A.request_code = 'L' AND SUBSTR(A.create_date,1,6) = #{yearMonth} AND B.hr_organ = #{department} GROUP BY A.user_id,B.hr_organ ) A
